key.name: device-modes
key.description: Maps a device name to an effect name, e.g. {'HP Omen 30L': 'Static'}.

key.name: device-speeds
key.description: Maps a device name to 0 (slowest) .. 100 (fastest). Only moving effects use it.

key.name: device-min-brightness
key.summary: Dimmest point of a pulsing effect per device, percent

key.name: device-max-brightness
key.summary: Brightest point of a pulsing effect per device, percent

key.name: lcd-enabled
key.summary: Cooler LCD on or off (off shows a black screen)

key.name: lcd-image
key.summary: Image shown on the cooler LCD
key.description: Absolute path. Empty leaves the built-in OMEN logo.

key.name: lcd-fit
key.summary: fill crops the image to cover the screen; fit shows all of it with black bars

key.name: lcd-recent-images
key.summary: Recently used LCD images, newest first, at most 8

key.name: auto-enabled
key.summary: Auto mode: match the lights and LCD to the app in use

key.name: auto-lights
key.summary: In auto mode, colour the lights from the focused app's icon

key.name: auto-lcd
key.summary: In auto mode, show the focused app's icon on the LCD

key.name: focused-app
key.summary: Written by the extension: the app that has focus
key.description: An app id such as 'firefox.desktop'. Only kept up to date while auto mode is on.

key.name: status
key.description: JSON: {"lcd": bool, "openrgb": bool, "ram": bool, "error": str, "auto": {"app": str, "colour": str}, "devices": [{"name": str, "modes": [str], "zones": [str]}]}
